target_gate_results.criterion: The same opaque one-piece follows torso, waist and hip contours through readable shaped seams and small tension folds.
target_gate_results.evidence: At native 1070x1470 and thumbnail 326x448, the teal one-piece narrows through the waist and follows the torso and hip outline. Its central seam and waist seam stay on the same fitted garment while the tan coat remains outside it. At native scale, neckline stitching, the central shaped seam, horizontal waist seam, leg seams and small lateral tension folds prove an actual textile surface. The teal fabric has a textured finish and joins coherently across the one-piece.

target_gate_results.criterion: Solid textile covers chest, abdomen and pelvis continuously.
target_gate_results.evidence: At both scales, continuous solid teal textile covers the chest, abdomen and pelvis. The surface is uniformly opaque; skin detail is not transmitted through those garment regions.

target_gate_results.criterion: A separate loose tan coat has outward front edges, broad folds and clear draping distance from the fitted base.
target_gate_results.evidence: At both scales, the teal fitted jumpsuit and tan loose coat have distinct colors, edges, sleeves and surfaces. The tan front edges frame the separate central teal garment rather than one printed panel. At both scales, the tan raised sleeve has broad hanging folds and an open cuff volume; both coat fronts stand out beside the fitted teal waist and hips. The underlying garment remains fitted while the outer layer has visible ease.

target_gate_results.criterion: Adult face is readable, with visible short dark bob and airy bangs broadly consistent with the portrait reference; this does not establish identity.
target_gate_results.evidence: The image depicts the configured adult fashion actor with grown facial proportions, a short dark bob and airy bangs. Face is clearly visible and broadly follows the reference appearance; this visual judgment does not establish identity.

target_gate_results.criterion: The right hand turns the exterior brass yoke tilt knob, lamp stands beside her, torso is balanced over legs.
target_gate_results.evidence: At native scale, the actor-right fingertips meet the outer rim of the round brass tilt knob attached to the lamp side yoke. Hand and knob retain distinct contact boundaries and sit beside the torso; the coat sleeve has room for the bent forearm. At native scale, the upright torso is above a coherent pelvis and two downward trousered legs; the lamp stand has visible base feet on the stone floor. The subject feet are outside the requested head-through-knees crop, so direct sole-floor contact is unverified, while the visible balance and load relations agree with standing.

target_gate_results.criterion: Face, fitted torso/waist/hips, both outer coat edges and operative hand coexist visibly in head-through-knees framing.

The lamp sits to the side and does not occlude the central garment structure; the lower-leg crop is consistent with the requested scale.
